newsitem.title: USA: Explosion sends cloud of smoke over Austin.
newsitem.headline: Explosion sends cloud of smoke over Austin.

text.p: An explosion at an electrical station knocked out power to 35,000 utility customers and sent huge clouds of black smoke rolling across downtown Austin on Monday, police said.
Traffic lights in the city center went dark, creating afternoon rush hour chaos and causing several traffic accidents, they said.
News reports said the fire began in an electric transformer and spread to a 1,500-gallon (5,678-litre) tank of mineral oil, which was used to cool the power station.
A police spokesman said there were no reports of injuries or fatalities at the fire scene. The power plant, located near downtown, was owned by the City of Austin.
